reason: The dense knot and nearby cold cloud seem like a direct way to investigate whether the surviving clumps can form stars.
expectation: The cold gas may feed the knot and help it form new stars, though it might need another step.

alternatives.reason: The young stars may reveal what happens to nearby dust, but I want to follow the surviving clumps first.

effect: The surviving clumps helped form new stars, completing that goal; I’ll follow the dust next.
reaction: It’s satisfying to see the old pillars contribute to new lights.
reason: The young stars and nearby dust should show what happens to dust that remains in their light.
expectation: I expect the starlight to change or illuminate the dust, though I’m unsure how.

alternatives.reason: The outflow could show the dust’s other path, but I’ll try the starlight first.

effect: The dust absorbs starlight and radiates infrared; the inherited-dust goal remains open, so I’ll follow its outflow path.
reaction: The distinction between glowing gas and warmed grains is interesting.
reason: Combining the outflow with nearby dusty gas follows the second path described in the chapter introduction.
expectation: I expect the outflow to carry some dust away from the nursery, though its eventual destination is unclear.

alternatives.reason: The warmed dust might also travel in the outflow, but I’ll follow the nearby dusty gas first.

effect: The outflow carries dust away, with some grains sheltered in clumps; the remaining action follows it into the outer galaxy.
reaction: The contrast between sheltered and exposed grains is interesting.
reason: This is the only offered combination and should show what happens to the carried dust in the hot outer gas.
expectation: The dust may disperse or be altered by the hot gas; I’m unsure whether the grains survive.

effect: The hot outer gas erodes many dust grains, completing the inherited-dust goal and the chapter.
reaction: The grains returning to the gas was a striking end to their journey.

mostWorthwhile.text: Following the surviving clumps into new stars was satisfying: material from the old pillars helped make new lights beyond the nursery.

leastWorthwhile.text: The final hotspot action was straightforward and the only offered combination, so it involved little decision-making.

surprise.text: Warmed dust radiates absorbed energy in infrared, while grains carried outward can later be eroded by hot gas.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless; the last followed the dust into the outer gas, although it was the only offered action.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to follow how the dispersed material meets the galaxy again; the connected paths of gas and dust were interesting.
